ast.scope: Explicit gap: no syntax projection or semantic AST.

obernants.scope: Let U be valid World/query/filter to fact-and-score observations with sent>=1 and finite totals. R builds, scores and sorts. U minus R includes a kept result violating deterministic score ordering or equal-score n ordering, and built n values unequal to positions. Semantic truth and public malformed facts remain outside this projection.

For an observed ranked projection y, R^-1(y) includes all worlds, queries and filters producing y. Dropped fields, unmatched query alternatives and omitted facts create ambiguity; rank or score never uniquely recovers world history.
Build first appends facts in category iteration order, then sorts by (line,old n) and resets n. Equal-line ties preserve insertion order; final n is not entity ID or sentence number.

B::push sets sent=first anchor or 1; event construction overwrites sent with e.pos.sent. Thus anchors can be empty or differ from scored sentence; labels display all anchors without guaranteeing support.
Field lemma set is lemset(text) union lemset(ent_text(id)) over IDs. Repeated lemma occurrences collapse in HashSet, while fields and their ID vectors retain their separate multiplicity.
Predicate contributes exactly 3 iff any query predicate alternative matches the first Pred field's lemma set. Further matching predicates do not add points.

For nonempty q.who, in-role membership yields +3 and who=true; only-any-field membership yields +1 and who=true; absence yields -2 and who=false. Empty q.who contributes zero. Agent tests f.who across all current Kind variants.
Each occurrence in q.others contributes 1.5 if f.has_id, so duplicate IDs repeat the bonus. This list is not set-normalized by score.
For each q.words alternative group, add the maximum weight among matching fields, or zero. Sum across groups; repeating a group repeats its contribution. Pred=1.5, When/About=0.5, other slots=1.
Search applies keep before scoring and sorts descending finite score, then ascending n. Every permutation sharing tied scores and n compares equal; unique build n gives a total order.

Plans/beliefs use current values but first-state line/anchor; attributes use deltas per state. Feeling emits added tags, or an end only when empty after nonempty; partial removals have no standalone removal fact.
Label keeps src/key, Value only for Attr/Have/Part, all anchors and cause; it omits line, sent, neg, end, by and most fields. Distinct contradictory or ended facts can share a label.

Let P be first-predicate hit, H in {0,6,2,-4} the subject half-points, O the matching other-ID occurrence count, W the sum of per-word maximum weights in half-units, and T in {0,6,5,1,-3} the ordered section half-bonus. For bounded counts 2*score=6P+H+3O+W+T. Diagnostic words=W/2. This is an exact real-valued specification only while binary half-unit accumulation is representable; tests use small counts. Independent integer coefficients avoid using Slot::weight as their oracle.
